1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.OctahedralPairedBounds
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.WiderCutRays
3 
4 /-! Case A is automatic for the actual petals under the sharper-pole rule. -/
5 
6 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph.Development
7 
8 open Real EuclideanGeometry OctahedralTriangles
9 
10 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {graph : P.SixVertexGraph}
11 variable {small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
12   (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4} {source : Fin 6} {slit : Fin 4}
13 variable (net : graph.Development small_faces source slit)
14 
15 /-- The paired-pole curvature inequality alone supplies both wider angle bounds;
16 all remaining inputs are derived from the same actual development. -/
17 theorem opposite_petals_caseA_of_paired_poles (i : Fin 2)
18     (source_order : graph.curvature (opposite source) ≤ graph.curvature source)
19     (narrow : net.widenedLeft i + net.widenedRight i < π) :
20     net.Separated (true, i.castSucc.castSucc) (true, i.succ.succ) := by
21   let previous := net.patch i.castSucc.castSucc
22   let middle := net.patch i.castSucc.succ
23   let next := net.patch i.succ.succ
24   let base := dist middle.left middle.right
25   let s := dist middle.left middle.apex
26   let t := dist middle.right middle.apex
27   let φ := angle middle.right middle.left middle.apex
28   let ψ := angle middle.left middle.right middle.apex
29   let α := net.widenedLeft i
30   let β := net.widenedRight i
31   let lam := net.petalApexAngle i.castSucc.castSucc
32   let rho := net.petalApexAngle i.succ.succ
33   have lam_small : lam < π := net.petalApexAngle_lt_pi _
34   have rho_small : rho < π := net.petalApexAngle_lt_pi _
35   have bounds := net.opposite_wider_apex_bounds i source_order
36   have base_pos : 0 < base := dist_pos.mpr (ne₁₂_of_not_collinear middle.petal_noncollinear)
37   have s_pos : 0 < s := dist_pos.mpr (ne₁₃_of_not_collinear middle.petal_noncollinear)
38   have t_pos : 0 < t := dist_pos.mpr (ne₂₃_of_not_collinear middle.petal_noncollinear)
39   have φ_pos : 0 < φ := by
40     apply angle_pos_of_not_collinear
41     simpa only [Set.insert_comm] using middle.petal_noncollinear
42   have ψ_pos : 0 < ψ := angle_pos_of_not_collinear middle.petal_noncollinear
43   have left_wider : φ < α := by
44     have positive := graph.curvature_pos small_faces (fanNeighbor source ((slit + i.castSucc.castSucc) + 1))
45     change φ < φ + _
46     linarith
47   have right_wider : ψ < β := by
48     have positive := graph.curvature_pos small_faces (fanNeighbor source ((slit + i.castSucc.succ) + 1))
49     change ψ < ψ + _
50     linarith
51   obtain ⟨motion, first, second, apex⟩ := exists_upper_triangle_frame middle.left middle.right middle.apex middle.petal_noncollinear
52   have reverses := net.upper_patch_frame_reverses i.castSucc.succ motion first second apex
53   have middle_right := upper_triangle_frame_right _ _ _ middle.petal_noncollinear motion first second apex
54   have at_previous := net.previous_apex_in_upper_frame i.castSucc motion first second apex
55   change motion previous.apex = s • direction α at at_previous
56   have at_next := net.next_apex_in_upper_frame i.succ motion first second apex
57   change motion next.apex = base • direction 0 + t • direction (π - ψ -
58     graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source ((slit + i.castSucc.succ) + 1))) at at_next
59   have right_direction : π - ψ - graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source ((slit + i.castSucc.succ) + 1)) = π - β := by
60     change π - ψ - _ = π - (ψ + _)
61     ring
62   rw [right_direction] at at_next
63   have cones := CutRays.caseA_wider_cones base s t α β φ ψ lam rho (motion middle.apex)
64     base_pos s_pos t_pos φ_pos ψ_pos left_wider right_wider narrow apex middle_right
65     (net.petalApexAngle_pos _) lam_small (net.petalApexAngle_pos _) rho_small
66     (net.opposite_outer_angle_sum i) bounds.1.le bounds.2.le
67   rw [show π + α = α + π by ring] at cones
68   have shared_left : motion previous.right = 0 := by
69     change motion (net.patch i.castSucc.castSucc).right = 0
70     rw [net.consecutive_patch_corner]
71     exact first
72   have shared_right : motion next.left = base • direction 0 := by
73     change motion (net.patch i.succ.succ).left = _
74     rw [← net.consecutive_patch_corner i.succ]
75     exact second
76   have left_edge : motion previous.right - motion previous.apex = s • direction (α + π) := by
77     rw [shared_left, at_previous, direction_add_pi]
78     module
79   have right_edge : motion next.left - motion next.apex = t • direction (-β) := by
80     have direction_eq : direction (π - β) = -direction (-β) := by
81       rw [show π - β = -β + π by ring, direction_add_pi]
82     rw [shared_right, at_next, direction_eq]
83     module
84   have left_contained := net.petal_image_in_clockwise_cone i.castSucc.castSucc motion reverses s (α + π - lam) (α + π)
85     s_pos left_edge (by rw [angle_comm]; change lam ≤ _; linarith) (by linarith)
86   have right_contained := net.petal_image_in_counterclockwise_cone i.succ.succ motion reverses t (-β) (-β + rho)
87     t_pos right_edge (by change rho ≤ _; linarith) (by linarith)
88   rw [at_previous] at left_contained
89   rw [at_next] at right_contained
90   have safe := cones.mono (interior_mono left_contained) (interior_mono right_contained)
91   change Disjoint (interior (motion.toHomeomorph '' net.placedTriangle (true, i.castSucc.castSucc)))
92     (interior (motion.toHomeomorph '' net.placedTriangle (true, i.succ.succ))) at safe
93   rw [← motion.toHomeomorph.image_interior, ← motion.toHomeomorph.image_interior] at safe
94   exact (Set.disjoint_image_iff motion.injective).mp safe
95 
96 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph.Development
